landing.title: Toasthub
landing.tagline: Count your toasts, keep your streak and out-toast your friends.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Set up your profile. You can change all of this later in settings.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist or was moved.

placeholder.body: This page is still in the toaster. Check back soon.

toastOfTheWeek.title: Toast of the week
toastOfTheWeek.empty: No winner yet. Every Monday one photo toast from the week before is drawn.

log.title: Log toasts
log.description: How many toasts did you have? A photo is optional.

photo.noPreview: This browser can't preview the photo, but it will upload fine.
photo.tooLarge: This photo is larger than 10 MB. Pick a smaller one.
photo.invalid: We can't read this file. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.

toasts.empty: No toasts yet. Log your first one from home.

edit.title: Edit toasts
edit.description: Logged at {{time}}. You can change it until midnight.
edit.photoHidden: An admin hid this photo. You can remove it, but not replace it.
edit.photoLocked: An admin hid the photo of these toasts, so they can't get a new one.

delete.title: Delete these toasts?
delete.description_one: This {{count}} toast leaves your counts and streak. You can't undo it.
delete.description_other: These {{count}} toasts leave your counts and streak. You can't undo it.

profilePage.reduced: {{name}} shares stats, achievements and photos with clanmates only.

login.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to log in. No password needed.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We sent a login link to {{email}}. It works once, within 15 minutes.

callback.deadLink: This login link has expired or was already used. We can send you a new one.
callback.failed: We couldn't log you in with this link. Request a new one below.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: Other people see this name. 2 to 30 characters.

visibility.label: Who can see your profile
visibility.publicHint: Any signed-in user sees your stats, achievements and photos.
visibility.clanHint: Others see only your name, avatar and leaderboard counts.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the details aren't valid. Check them and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.CONFLICT: That's no longer possible. Refresh and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach Toasthub. Check your connection.

shutterbug.name: Shutterbug
shutterbug.description: Log your first toast with a photo
